title: Intermittent mailbox read failures on a known, previously-read mailbox: transient 404 "mailbox not found for this session" and 410 readKeyExpired, both succeeding on immediate retry
outcome: A root session's read of a mailbox it belongs to, and has read and acknowledged before, does not fail transiently. If a read is refused, the error names the real cause and says whether an identical retry is safe; a 404 is never returned for a mailbox the caller is a participant of.
acceptance: The cause of the transient 404 'mailbox not found for this session' on a mailbox the caller participates in is identified and fixed, or the response is replaced by a typed retryable error, with a test reproducing the condition
The 410 readKeyExpired observed with no central restart is explained (which frozen page/key expired and why) and either prevented or documented as expected with its retry rule
Both reported calls below are accounted for in the item notes
